result.summary: Applied design §2.2/§3.1-3.3 to test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs. EO-004 (L390-391 previously): replaced the hardcoded 'completed'/'completed_at != nil' literal with an invariant check -- query every Outcome row for first_result.rollout.id directly via Repo.all/Ecto.Query, then branch: if every one of those outcomes is 'succeeded', assert status == 'completed' and completed_at != nil; otherwise assert status == 'running' and completed_at == nil. EO-005: (1) L410 blanket Enum.all?(first_result.outcomes, ...) replaced with two outcome_for/2 lookups scoped to good_a.tenant_id/good_b.tenant_id; (2) L412-413 global Rollout/Outcome table counts replaced with a direct reload-and-compare of the one Rollout row (Repo.get!/2 before and after, struct equality) and an Outcome count scoped to rollout_id AND tenant_id in [good_a.tenant_id, good_b.tenant_id]; (3) L423 blanket Enum.all?(second_result.outcomes, & &1.already_current) replaced with two outcome_for/2-scoped lookups for good_a/good_b. Did not touch lib/letflow/platform/migration_rollout.ex or any other test file, per the design's explicit no-production-change confirmation. mix format applied (reformatted the new blocks only). mix test test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs: 12 tests, Result: 12 passed, 0 failures (includes EO-001/002/003, the ISS-0716 'queryable outcome record' precedent, registration-conflict, crash-recovery, scope-resolution, and ISS-0777 describe blocks, all unmodified and still green). Verification plan (design §5): (1) structural argument -- re-read the diff; no remaining branch in EO-004/EO-005 reads or compares a global/all-tenant/all-rollout-scoped value except EO-004's two invariant-derived branches, which are intentionally scope-free by design (they assert a rule against whatever the real outcome set is, not a fixed value). (2) Empirical: reran ISSUE-FIXER's own repro harness (migration_rollout_test.exs concurrent, unpartitioned, alongside the same 9 TenantFixture-heavy sibling files: tenant_provisioning_test.exs, column_promotion_test.exs, routers/tenants_test.exs, routers/tenant_solutions_test.exs, definitions/solution_pack_test.exs, service_catalog_test.exs, identity/tenant_test.exs, routers/instances_test.exs, routers/entities_test.exs) for 3 iterations with distinct seeds (1001, 20260927, 77777): 328 passed / 0 failed on every iteration, exit 0 each time -- same clean outcome ISSUE-FIXER itself got pre-fix (328/328/328, 0 failures), so this run neither newly failed nor (given the pre-fix baseline was already clean) demonstrates the race firing; it does confirm zero regression under the same load profile. Attempted TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 scripts/test_parallel.sh (the exact command that produced ISS-0829's original failure) once: it did not complete within a 580s budget in this environment (setup+migration phase for 4 partitions finished, but the full-suite partition run itself did not finish in time) -- reporting this honestly rather than claiming a result I did not observe; did not retry further given the 3x-200s harness runs already consumed significant session time and the harness is the more targeted reproduction vector for this exact mechanism. (3) Regression check: confirmed via the same 12/12 isolated run above -- EO-001/002/003 and the ISS-0716 precedent test pass unchanged.
